lines.text: Another Sworn, fresh off the forge-table. Steel in your bones and Midgard in your blood. Welcome to Gladsheim.
No time for songs. The heat-lines from Nidavellir have gone cold. Midgard is freezing from the outer wall inward.
Something in the Iron Wood is cutting them. The gate will take you there. Find it, and stop it.
Brokkr will arm you, the rune-carver will sharpen what he makes, and the board has work if you want charms. Mind the Valkyries: they carry the fallen home, and they keep a toll.
The heat-line runs through here. It's been torn open, not worn through.
Rime-engines and thralls by the dozen. Something drove them south. Keep moving north and you'll find what.
Feel that wind? The Fimbulwinter surges here. Stand near a burning brazier when it comes, or it will freeze you where you stand.
Unlit braziers take a spark: a shot, a burning blow, or your own hand.
A Well of Wyrd. The Norns keep one rule in each. Here: nothing touching the ground can be hurt.
Lift them, then cut them down. Win, and the well gives a sigil and whatever it keeps.
Bones and slag, and something heavy breathing in the dark.
An iron troll. Break its legs and it kneels; climb it then. Break its arms and it stops throwing.
Its last swipe splits your plating and finds the flesh beneath. Cold pours in.
Come home, Sworn. My well can mend you as you were: quicker, and still flesh. Or Brokkr can mend you as you could be: steel, and heavier for it.
Come to the well when you are ready to choose. Either way, the well remembers, and you may choose again.
Flesh remembers. You will be faster for it, and you will bleed for it. Go well.
The cut came from the forges themselves. Nidavellir. The gate is open to it now.
There. Steel doesn't feel cold and doesn't feel fear. Hit harder. Try not to forget why.
